title: Close every selected scenario condition and measured wave acceptance gate
owner: Root portfolio owner with dedicated semantic, implementation and independent product reviewers
resolution: OPEN: completion is blocked until every retained selected scenario has the accepted-source p3-portfolio graph/rights/user-contract conditions and F2–F6 closed by scoped evidence. This includes all unresolved_assertion_ids and unasserted user-schema gaps; exact unit/quantity factors, language/locale and time/category projections; IANA scalar/range/compound-key projections; source-specific NVD/ORR rights; ROR embedded GeoNames attribution; null/multiplicity/historical coverage; W1 complete-source key-closure/resource/query budgets; ordinary query projections and capability/allowlist behavior; canonical pins/manifests/registry publication; actual explicit bounded DataTug network queries with provenance and visible mismatches; independent validation and stopping decision. Specific research packets remain separately tracked in p3-followup-1..6 and F1 in canonical-semantic-ingestion; B1 remains independent. Evidence paths and all 37 source modes are frozen by p3-phase-acceptance source hashes. Architecture pass does not close any condition. Scoped root-reviewed deferral may narrow the portfolio but must preserve backlog, counts/reasons and gates; no silent removal, arbitrary subset, implied rights or unmeasured resource acceptance. CLI/multiserver parity is not mandatory unless a selected journey needs it.
